note: ASSUMED SHAPE: Latchkey has published no webhook fixture yet; this is the shape the platform builds against until it does (the goal the-platform-reads-a-token-by-ref-or-slug, item 5), and is replaced by Latchkey's when it exists. A delivery is a JSON object naming its event, its id, and the org and tenant it is about — each by ref for an org moved onto generated refs (the refs are the same ones gateway/testdata/token-ref-form.json carries for runsheet/grapevine) or by key (the legacy org name and tenant slug) otherwise. A tenant given as a whole namespace (`<org>/<tenant>`) is read by its last segment.

headers.X-Latchkey-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body under LATCHKEY_WEBHOOK_SECRET>

responses.platform: the delivery matched an Org by latchkey_tenant_ref or tenant_slug and LatchkeyWebhookReceived is logged on it
verified, but naming no Org the platform knows (or no event): acknowledged, nothing recorded
the signature is missing or wrong
LATCHKEY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset: the mount is not there
